as indicated by Y1 in the title block

The SIPROTEC 4 7UM62 is a numerical, multi-functional, protective and 
 control device equipped with a powerful microprocessor. All tasks, such as 
 the acquisition of the measured quantities, issuing of commands to circuit 
 breakers and other primary power system equipment, are processed in a 
 completely digital way.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Mansor, tested by eng Sidhom Nasef, 
revised by MDEPC Quality control eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by eng Ali 
Zahran: general manager,
approved by eng. 
Ahmed Sawan: head sector of Nubaria PS, 
certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general 
director, and approved by eng. Mohamed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection 
and quality control.
A work permit must be issued.

Wear 
 your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

sections.text:
Steps to 
prepare for 
relay testing

items:
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.

Be sure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying a DC voltmeter 
 across points (f1, f2 -- see figure 1) on the rear of the relay.

sections.text: FOR MAIN GENERATOR UNIT OF CTG

items: Connecting the Personal Computer to the ISA tester.
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.

After ISA tester completely in service Connect Currents, Voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and SIPROTEC 4 7UM62.

RUN ISAWIZARD software >>>>> GENERATION and DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> X pro 
 advanced >>>> MANUAL MODE
NOW you can test the relay.

Insert the current terminals to Q1,Q3,Q5 (see figure 2).
 Note: Do not forget to GENERATE PREFAULT
 CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=0V].
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay.

Choose Shoot with current value equal to 1.05 of pick up current to get 
 pickup time of the relay.
Now print the results and you have complete test results for this function.
RUN ISAWIZARD software and chose GENERATION AND DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> X-PRO >>>> MANUAL MODE >>>>
Insert the current terminals to Q1,Q3,Q5 (see figure 2).
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I = 0.001A].
Disable other functions.
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay.

Select fault and shoot current value equal to ( I Setting*1.05 ) to determine 
 the operating time.
 Note that: the injection should be on phase R only.
STORE ALL TESTS

RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION and DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> 
 X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE >>>>
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=57V].
Disable other functions.

SELECT FAULT and INJECT CURRENT VALUE EQUAL TO (I Setting*1.01) to determine 
 the operating time.
Click Start.

Repeat steps from 3-1, to 3-5 for all phases R, S, and T.
 Note that: you can inject on three phase one time.
Choose STORE ALL TESTS.
RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION and DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> X-PRO >>>> MANUAL MODE >>>>
Insert the current terminals to Q1,Q3,Q5 (see figure 2).
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [ I = 0.001A ].
Disable other functions.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay.
 NOTE: Ia=3 x Io =3 x I2 WHERE:
 Ia: Phase current, Io: Zero sequence current and I2: Negative sequence 
 component.

Select fault and shoot current value equal to (I Setting*1.05) to determine 
 the operating time.
 Note that: The injection should be on phase R only.
STORE ALL TESTS

RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION and DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> 
 X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>
Insert the voltage terminals to R15,R17,R18,R16 (see figure 3).
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=57V].
Disable other functions.

SELECT FAULT and inject voltage value equal to (V setting) to determine the 
 operating time for each stage.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆V 1V to get pickup voltage for each stage of the 
 relay.
 Note that: You can inject on three phase one time.
Chose STORE ALL TESTS.

RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION and DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> 
 X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>
Insert the voltage terminals to R15,R17,R18,R16 (see figure 3).
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=57V, 50 Hz].
Disable other functions.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆F 0.5 Hz to get pickup frequency for each stage 
 of the relay.
 Note that : You can inject on three phase one time.

SELECT FAULT and inject voltage value equal to (V nominal) with frequency 
 setting to determine the operating time for each stage.
Chose STORE ALL TESTS.

RUN ISAWIZARD software and chose GENERATION AND DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> 
 X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>
GENERATE PREFAULT CODITION [I=0.001A, V=57V].
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.001 Amp to get pickup current for the relay.

SELECT FAULT and INJECT CURRENT VALUE EQUAL to I Setting and angle 180ْ and 
 voltage value equal to nominal voltage determine the operating time.
Click Start.

Repeat steps from 3-1, to 3-5 for all phases R, S, and T.
 Note that: You can inject on three phase one time.
Chose STORE ALL TESTS

sections.text:
Return
relay and
associated equipment to
service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and VT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED's on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to 
 those for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, 
 Mvar, Amperes and 
 Power Factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
